# Lexalytic
> Lexalytic is a UK digital studio. We build websites, custom business software, AI-powered tools, and data systems for UK businesses. Fixed price. Fast delivery. Based in Hertfordshire.

## Services
- Bespoke website development (Next.js, no WordPress, no platform fees)
- Custom business software (CRMs, rotas, job trackers, client portals)
- AI-powered business tools (Claude AI integration, proposal generators, document processors)
- Platform and SaaS development (full web applications, booking systems, member platforms)
- Power BI dashboards and data visualisation
- Excel and data automation
- Workflow automation (Power Automate, Python)
- Data cleansing and quality

## Portfolio
- Lexalytic (lexalytic.com) - digital studio marketing site, SEO score 100
- CVCraft AI (cvcraft-ai.co.uk) - AI-powered CV rewriting service with Stripe payments
- FamilyEntitled (familyentitled.co.uk) - UK government entitlements calculator
- Kismet (kismetplans.com) - UK wedding planning platform (in development)
